title: Orbit roadmap: sprint harmonization & OKR sync for hosted API + model catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Quarterly Alignment
description: Quarterly planning ticket to align product, engineering, and design around a coordinated sprint plan and OKR mapping for Hosted API + Model Catalog. Goal is to produce a binding quarter roadmap with clear commit lanes (core deliverables, hedges, and experiment lanes), a canary window schedule for model rotations, and a lightweight governance flow for rollouts and rollbacks. This ticket captures artifacts, decision points, and stakeholder signoffs required to move the roadmap from draft into a committed sprint plan.
success_metrics: Roadmap commit for Q1 published and accepted by Eng/Design/Sales by 2026-02-28
OKR mapping completed with measurable targets (latency P50/P95, unit cost per 1M tokens, model health regression rate) by 2026-03-05
Canary schedule defined covering 90% of hosted endpoints and 100% of high-risk model swaps
Capacity hedge plan validated with infra for 2x seasonal surge simulation
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated sprint backlog exported to shared Planboard with per-ticket owners and estimates
Rollout cadence (canary windows, A/B lanes, automatic fallback) documented and linked to Console runbook
Dependencies resolved or triaged with owners and explicit risk plans
Stakeholder signoff recorded from Runtime, Platform, and Solutions engineering leads
risks: Model regressions during rotation could increase error rates if canary coverage is incomplete
Under-provisioned Dedicated pools may cause SLA breaches during coordinated rollouts
Conflicting priorities across product teams could push critical infra tasks into later cycles
updates: 2026-01-12 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting held with Runtime and Infra. Agreed on three commitment lanes: Core delivery, Hedged capacity tasks, and Experimental model trials. Action: runtime to produce latency heatmap by 2026-01-19.

2026-01-20 - Devon Brooks: Latency heatmap uploaded to dashboard; observed higher P95 for long-context endpoints. Proposal: tighten batching windows for long-context routes which impacts batching config task estimate.
2026-01-22 - Marisol Vega: Design reviewed preliminary Console flows for canary scheduling. Feedback: reduce modal depth for schedule creation; provided updated wireframes (link in 'links').

2026-01-28 - Priya Kapoor: Infra simulation shows Dedicated pool needs +30% capacity to satisfy surge hedges; recommended a staged autoscaling buffer and a will-call burst lane. Assigned action to ENG-1842 for autoscaling policy changes.

2026-02-03 - Liam Chen: Draft OKR mapping posted. Target metrics proposed: reduce median token cost by 18%, maintain P95 latency below 220ms for short-context, and reduce model regression alerts by 40% through improved eval gates.
2026-02-09 - Olivia Nguyen: Analytics validated OKR baselines and suggested per-route health signals for regression detection. Action: add per-route eval sets to the rollout gating checklist.

2026-02-15 - Aisha Patel: Cross-functional review - Design/Runtime/Infra accepted core plan pending two items: (1) final canary window policy, (2) fallthrough fallback mapping for multi-region outages. Those are scoped as carry-ins with owners assigned.

2026-02-20 - Liam Chen: Moved ticket into 'Planned' with final artifacts attached. Next milestone: stakeholder signoff meeting on 2026-02-25 to lock sprint allocations. Linked follow-ups: PM-46211 (dependency) and ENG-32250 (batching kernel experiments).
